Learning Sciences.Cognitive and Motivational Processes: Experimental studies on how students acquire knowledge and skills, including memory, attention, metacognition, motivation, and engagement in real or simulated learning environments.
Learning Sciences.Problem Solving and Reasoning: Controlled experiments investigating reasoning, conceptual change, and problem-solving strategies across domains like math, science, and computational thinking.
Learning Sciences.Technology Enhanced Learning: Empirical evaluation of digital learning tools, online platforms, simulations, and adaptive learning systems, including randomized trials and A/B testing.

STEM Education.Mathematics Education: Experiments and quasi-experiments testing instructional approaches, curricula, and interventions in K-12 and higher education mathematics learning.
STEM Education.Science Education: Laboratory- and classroom-based studies of science teaching strategies, lab instruction effectiveness, inquiry-based learning, and concept understanding.
STEM Education.Engineering and Computational Education: Field experiments and controlled studies on project-based learning, coding education, robotics, and engineering design thinking.

Literacy and Language Education.Reading and Writing: Experimental studies on literacy interventions, reading comprehension strategies, writing skill development, and early literacy programs.
Literacy and Language Education.Second Language Acquisition: Empirical studies on teaching methods, immersion programs, bilingual education, and technology-mediated language learning.

Educational Psychology and Assessment.Assessment and Evaluation: Research on test design, formative and summative assessment, learning analytics, validity/reliability studies, and experimental evaluation of assessment interventions.
Educational Psychology and Assessment.Self Regulated and Metacognitive Learnin: Experiments studying strategies to improve student self-monitoring, goal-setting, and independent learning skills.
Educational Psychology and Assessment.Motivation and Engagement Interventions: Controlled trials of interventions targeting intrinsic/extrinsic motivation, mindset, interest development, and persistence in learning.

Teacher Education and Professional Devel.Pre Service Teacher Training: Experimental and longitudinal studies evaluating pre-service programs, instructional coaching, and skill acquisition in teacher candidates.
Teacher Education and Professional Devel.In Service Professional Development: Field experiments testing the effectiveness of workshops, mentoring, and collaborative professional learning communities on teacher practice and student outcomes.

Special Education and Inclusive Educatio.Disability and Learning Differences: Experimental studies on interventions for students with disabilities, neurodiverse learners, and individualized education programs (IEPs).
Special Education and Inclusive Educatio.Inclusive Teaching Strategies: Empirical evaluation of classroom practices, peer support structures, and accommodations to improve learning outcomes for diverse student populations.

Higher Education and Adult Learning.Curriculum and Instruction in Higher Edu: Experiments and quasi-experiments on teaching strategies, flipped classrooms, active learning, and competency-based education in postsecondary contexts.
Higher Education and Adult Learning.Lifelong and Adult Learning: Empirical studies on adult skill acquisition, continuing education, professional training programs, and workplace learning interventions.

Education Policy and Program Evaluation.Policy Impact Evaluation: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs), natural experiments, and quasi-experimental studies evaluating the effects of education policies and reforms.
Education Policy and Program Evaluation.Program and Intervention Evaluation: Experimental studies assessing the effectiveness of curricular, technological, or social interventions on learning outcomes and equity.

Data Science and Learning Analytics.Learning Data Analysis: Experimental and observational studies using large-scale educational datasets, predictive modeling, and A/B testing to study instructional effectiveness and student behavior.
Data Science and Learning Analytics.Adaptive and Personalized Learning Resea: Field trials and lab experiments testing adaptive learning systems, intelligent tutoring systems, and personalization algorithms in real-world educational settings.
